description: Install or update ADP config, capability help, output directories, installed resources, and safe legacy cleanup.
outputs: config.yaml, config.user.yaml, and module-help.csv; setup-run memlog under _bmad-output/adp/setup-runs; skill/schema/template/catalog and ELK version/license/checksum inspection; reported migration needs

description: Initialize or upgrade shared ADP memory without overwriting existing project facts.
outputs: ADP memory scaffold, cadence, schemas, baseline intake, program-status/flow-graph/management-panel snapshot directories, empty panel view directory, and starter views; never placeholder panel or graph artifacts

description: Propose and validate candidates, preview-token-protect approved revisions, and inspect or audit-recover orphan baseline locks.
outputs: program baseline and revision history; lock owner disposition and immutable recovery receipt; validation findings and preview diff

description: Create or normalize a Workstream Delivery Record with evidence, decision, readiness, and review-plan artifacts.
outputs: new WDR with evidence.md, decisions.md, and readiness.md; or a non-destructive registration patch plan

description: Discover or reuse a source-backed BMM/TEA checkpoint candidate without changing a WDR.
outputs: checkpoint candidate, source preview, authority checklist, warnings, and stable candidate ID

description: Confirm, dismiss, or supersede one checkpoint candidate with explicit authority and corrections.
outputs: confirmed, dismissed, or superseded checkpoint candidate with immutable source lineage

description: Sync one confirmed checkpoint candidate into ADP memory idempotently.
outputs: WDR checkpoint facts, evidence, decisions, readiness gaps, daily log, and optional status-sync intake

description: Sync one caller-confirmed compatibility checkpoint packet after reviewing its dry-run.
outputs: reviewed compatibility packet, WDR updates, daily log, and optional status-sync intake

description: Close meeting, offline, chat, or DingTalk evidence into replay-safe archives and owned ADP updates.
outputs: meeting archive and lineage receipt, append-only meeting history, typed current-field intents, exact action create/patch commands, and durable status-sync outbox

description: Apply lightweight WDR current-field, milestone, batch, or explicit action-projection updates.
outputs: WDR current-field and milestone mutations, optional explicit action projection refresh, daily log, and durable batch receipts

description: Create stable ledger actions while applying explicitly co-batched WDR or milestone deltas.
outputs: typed action creates, WDR current-field updates, action ledger/state, optional WDR projection sidecars, intent convergence, and durable receipts

description: Patch an exact existing action with optimistic revision checks while preserving omitted fields.
outputs: owner/status/action mutations, no-op detection, monotonic action revision, optional explicit WDR projection refresh, and exact action IDs

description: Apply one exact state-audit projection repair batch through a single-use token.
outputs: CAS-validated WDR/action-sidecar repair, nonce lifecycle, attempt receipt/index, retry signal, and exact action IDs

description: Verify and create one compatibility receipt for an exact historical successful status update.
outputs: content-bound historical execution evidence check, preview token, and compatibility receipt

description: List workstreams whose status sync is stale or has never completed.
outputs: read-only stale and never-synced workstream list

description: Review cross-workstream risks, dependencies, blockers, and changes, producing traceable views and decision packets.
outputs: risk matrix, dependency map, canonical risk-flow relation view, guarded structured relation updates, and Business Decision Packets

description: Index L0 artifacts and extract project gates, contracts, NFRs, evidence rules, impacts, and open questions.
outputs: persisted L0 summaries and extracted constraints; reported WDR gap suggestions

description: Evaluate acceptance and cutover readiness from source evidence, confirmations, decisions, and L0 constraints.
outputs: localized readiness Markdown and HTML, scorecards, and optional generated workstream readiness blocks

description: Audit input facts, source freshness, pending intents, and ledger/WDR/sidecar projection drift with exact repair identities.
outputs: input/artifact and panel gates, typed drift verdict, content-addressed findings with exact action IDs, deterministic repair batches, and pending-intent blockers

description: Generate or inspect the canonical overall project status, confidence, progress, dual-axis flow state, immutable snapshot, and period delta.
outputs: immutable program-status snapshot, canonical progress and flow-state JSON, localized status, weekly report, and project-lead views

description: Render the baseline-aware planned, forecast, actual, variance, revision, and unmapped roadmap views.
outputs: roadmap JSON and localized Markdown with baseline/status lineage; scoped runs use views/roadmaps/<scope>

description: Generate the canonical baseline topology, dual-axis state, scoped overlays, unmapped records, and layered graph identities.
outputs: canonical views/flow-graph.json plus immutable and latest snapshots/flow-graph JSON with topology/state/overlay identities

description: Render audience-specific FDE morning or business biweekly packs from canonical status and audited facts.
outputs: localized meeting pack Markdown, JSON distillate with canonical flow selection, omissions appendix, and write-back lineage at the default pack root

description: Stage audited upstream projections when needed, generate canonical candidates, or validate one caller-owned Management Panel policy.
args: {policy <project root>}|{--memory-root <path>}|{--selection-policy <policy.json>}|{--as-of YYYY-MM-DD}|{--period-start YYYY-MM-DD --period-end YYYY-MM-DD}|{--fde-period-start YYYY-MM-DD --fde-period-end YYYY-MM-DD}|{--force-full}
outputs: durable awaiting-policy run, flow/status/history candidate IDs, reusable policy template, validation result, resume plan, and canonical policy SHA

description: Detect source or policy changes, pending intents, invalidated projection nodes, and an exact interrupted plan without writing business facts.
outputs: read-only live source and policy fingerprint diff, pending intent IDs, invalidated node set, resume plan path, retry node, and recommended refresh mode

description: Freeze one durable source-to-panel refresh plan and retry cursor.
args: {plan <project root> --as-of YYYY-MM-DD}|{--memory-root <path>}|{--selection-policy <policy.json>}|{--period-start YYYY-MM-DD --period-end YYYY-MM-DD}|{--fde-period-start YYYY-MM-DD --fde-period-end YYYY-MM-DD}|{--force-full}
outputs: content-bound source inventory and selection-policy SHA, deterministic DAG plan, node states, and retry cursor

description: Apply or resume the planned producer DAG and atomically publish one converged Panel generation.
outputs: resumable producer outputs, awaiting-policy checkpoint, publication journal, refresh receipt, current Panel, metrics, and preserved prior Panel on failure

description: Inspect artifact integrity, source and policy freshness, publication eligibility, pending intents, selected drift, and interrupted refresh state.
outputs: freshness-gated open disposition, current Panel and policy identities, changed sources, drift count, resume plan, and owning recovery workflow

description: Compose and publish a Panel from already-audited canonical inputs and an explicit selection policy.
outputs: low-level composed Panel model, HTML, immutable snapshot, and current pointers; not an end-to-end refresh

description: Inspect one published Panel generation and optionally require its exact Panel ID.
outputs: read-only Panel artifact identity, integrity, lineage, and recovery disposition

description: Create an explicit immutable internal or shareable distribution archive from audited canonical inputs.
outputs: immutable internal-full or shareable-summary HTML and model archive from audited canonical inputs

description: Explain canonical overall status and return exact owner-workflow routing without rewriting facts.
outputs: lineage-validated canonical status summary, requested management view paths, and owning-workflow recommendations

description: Explain the canonical period delta and current delivery position.
outputs: lineage-validated period review and exact owning-workflow recommendations

description: Prepare a canonical FDE morning or business biweekly meeting readout.
outputs: scenario-specific canonical readout and meeting workflow routing

description: Read exact operational detail for one supported ADP diagnostic capability.
outputs: read-only source inventory, counts, cross-references, freshness data, and exact evidence paths

description: Route blocked or stale canonical state to the exact owning workflow.
outputs: lineage-aware recovery reason and exact owning-workflow recommendations

description: Assess whether a requested Panel view is ready for refresh or publication.
outputs: Panel readiness, policy and freshness evidence, and exact recovery workflow

description: Route an end-to-end Panel refresh through the owning orchestration workflow.
outputs: Panel refresh route and current convergence evidence

description: Return only a freshness-eligible converged Panel view path.
outputs: freshness-gated Panel path or exact blocked recovery route

description: Route an explicit Panel archive with its caller-owned distribution profile.
outputs: archive workflow route, distribution profile, and converged Panel identity
